better_answer_example: I'd like to give an example of how I applied my skills in a previous project. In my final year project, I worked on a learning portal for education, where I was responsible for core access. I identified and resolved login issues, which improved student access. This experience has taught me the importance of attention to detail and problem-solving in test automation engineering. I believe my skills in Selenium, Java, and TestNG, along with my experience in resolving complex issues, make me a strong candidate for this role.
